Name: KBJax's Revamped Portraits
Author: KBJax
Description:
I was personally never too big a fan of the character portraits in the game, so I decided to use the artistic skill I've been graciously given to provide new ones.
Currently Alex is the only character to have a new set of portraits, due to him being my favorite, however I do plan to gradually update this pack with new
portraits. So stay updated if you like the art! 

This mods is pretty simple to download, all it needs is SMAPI and Content Patcher. Just extract the files into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder and you should be 
all good :)
